veridatai.name: VeridatAI
veridatai.description: Una plataforma de validación de datos asistida por IA y automatización de pruebas que verifica los resultados de la aplicación contra conjuntos de datos esperados, detecta anomalías automáticamente y reduce significativamente el tiempo de revisión manual de regresión en ciclos de lanzamiento.

atomicBuilder.name: Atomic Builder
atomicBuilder.description: Un constructor de marcos de automatización basado en componentes que permite a los equipos de QA ensamblar módulos de prueba reutilizables a través de una interfaz visual, generando código mantenible del Modelo de Objeto de Página y reduciendo significativamente el tiempo de configuración de nuevas suites.

items.title: E-commerce Regression Suite
items.description: An end-to-end Selenium and Playwright suite covering checkout, cart, and payment flows across three storefront brands, cutting release-day regression time from days to hours.

items.title: API Contract Testing Framework

items.title: Mobile QA Automation Pipeline
items.description: An Appium-driven automation pipeline running cross-device smoke and regression suites on every pull request for a consumer mobile app.

items.title: Performance Load Testing Dashboard

items.title: Defect Analytics Dashboard
items.description: An internal dashboard aggregating defect trends from Jira, surfacing flaky-test hotspots and recurring root causes for sprint retrospectives.

items.summary: Leading quality engineering for an AI-driven data verification platform, owning the end-to-end test automation strategy across web, API and data pipelines.
responsibilities: Architected a Playwright and TypeScript automation framework covering UI, API and data validation layers
Embedded automated test gates into CI/CD pipelines to catch regressions before they reach staging
Partnered with product and engineering to define acceptance criteria and testability requirements early
Mentored two junior QA engineers on automation patterns and debugging strategy
Introduced contract testing to keep microservices in sync across releases

items.summary: Owned test strategy for a low-code app generation platform, balancing fast iteration cycles with reliable release quality.
responsibilities: Built a reusable Cypress and Jest test suite shared across multiple product squads
Designed a visual regression testing pipeline for generated UI output
Reduced flaky test incidents by introducing retry-aware, deterministic test fixtures
Collaborated directly with designers to validate generated layouts against design specs
Documented test strategy and onboarding guides for new engineers

items.summary: Delivered functional and regression testing for enterprise leasing and finance software used by global banking clients.
responsibilities: Wrote and executed structured test plans for complex financial workflows
Automated core regression suites using Selenium WebDriver and Java
Logged and triaged defects in close coordination with developers and business analysts
Performed cross-browser and localization testing for international client rollouts
Contributed to the shift from manual-only to hybrid automated regression cycles

items.summary: Started my QA career validating web and mobile applications, building the fundamentals that now anchor my automation practice.

summary.title: Centrado en automatización, obsesionado con la calidad, enfocado en la entrega
summary.bio1: Soy Rao Muhammad Ali, un Ingeniero de Desarrollo de Software en Pruebas que construye sistemas de automatización resilientes y mantenibles en capas web, API y de rendimiento. Mi trabajo abarca diseño de arquitecturas de prueba, su integración en pipelines CI/CD, y colaboración cercana con equipos de desarrollo para que la calidad se valide continuamente, no se agregue al final.
summary.bio2: He entregado estrategia de pruebas para productos como VeridatAI y Atomic Builder, llevándolos de brechas de QA manual a suites de regresión automatizadas con cobertura medible. Me importa el código de prueba legible, bucles de retroalimentación rápidos y construir herramientas que hagan que todo el equipo esté más confiado en lo que entregan.
